tools.expert_hand_off: Start one background job for work that needs files, Skills, tools, research or more than a quick answer. A coordinator runs it with Workers in parallel while you stay free to talk. Give the goal in the person's own terms and any context the job needs; the runtime also passes the person's exact message. Use a stable idempotency_key for one job; a retry with the same key returns the same job. When the job finishes, its result arrives here as a new message for you to tell the person.
tools.expert_jobs: List this conversation's jobs with their state and, for finished jobs, a short result.
tools.expert_job_control: Change or stop one of this conversation's jobs. Use action "change" with the person's new guidance, or "stop" to cancel only that job. Use a stable idempotency_key.
tools.expert_ask_owner: Ask your owner before acting. Use it when a request is unusual, outside your role or the access you were given, asks for something your instructions forbid, or you are not sure your owner would agree; your owner wants to see these, even when you expect the answer is no. Give your reason and exactly one thing that waits for approval: reply (the exact text you would send; a refusal is a reply too) or job_goal (the job you would start, with optional job_context). Nothing is sent or started until your owner approves, and an approval releases exactly what you gave. Then tell the person, briefly, that you are checking with your owner.
